meta.title: Four withdrawals, each under the daily cap, that add up to more than it
meta.breaks: 100 + 200 + 50 + 300 = 650 tokens against a 500 daily cap. Each withdrawal alone is within the cap; a guard that checks only the single amount withdraws all four.
meta.expected_safe_result: the guard withdraws the first three (350) and refuses inv-expire (350 + 300 > 500; by the fourth call it may also have expired, which refuses it too)
meta.author: hand-written for the withdraw suite (Arena, 2026-11-11)
